class: measured on this machine from the bytes on disk

catalogue.role: the competition fault catalogue (USGS quaternary faults + INGENIOUS), rasterised on the 100 m grid; 60,988 positive cells; int8; nodata -1. THIS is the object the corrections lane measures.
catalogue.provenance: owner mirror of https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/data/ existing_faults.tif; committed in this repo, verified at build time by scripts/prepare_data.py

sample.role: the organizer's sample submission, used by the format gate as the CRS/shape/transform reference
sample.provenance: owner mirror of example_submission.tif from the same data tab (dropbox mirror URL recorded in GEMSDOE data/bridge/manifest.json)

features.role: official 19-band GeoDAWN numerical feature stack, 100 m, EPSG:32611
features.provenance: assembled from shards on 2026-10-09T04:24Z; every shard hash matched the owner manifest before assembly

lidar_scarp.role: LiDAR calibration layer: int16, 7 bands, value/SCALE encodings (h_all m, strike_at deg, facing_at, cover fraction), built by GEMSDOE48 from 700 USGS 3DEP 1 m tiles (NV WestCentral EarthMRI 2020) resampled to 3 m and aggregated to the competition grid
lidar_scarp.provenance: buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE48@main data/external/h52_scarp3m_100m.tif, fetched through api.github.com blobs on 2026-10-09T04:27Z
lidar_scarp.pin_match: no pin (large stack: pinned via shard hashes)

footprint_sample.rule: sample_submission.tif finite mask (the organizer's own null convention)

sample_submission_forensics.note: MEASURED: the shipped sample submission is not an all-zero raster; it is the catalogue mask (NaN outside the footprint). Independently reproduces the GEMSDOE54 audit claim; logged as irregularity IR-56-001.

det_elev.description: det_elev - Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed

tmi_hg.description: tmi_hg - Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction

tmi.description: tmi - Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field

iso_grav_anom_hg.description: iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change

det_elev_slope.description: det_elev_slope - Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending

band_descriptions.1: mag_anom - Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
band_descriptions.2: rtp - Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
band_descriptions.3: tmi_hg - Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
band_descriptions.4: geod_2ndinv - Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
band_descriptions.5: iso_grav_anom_slope - Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
band_descriptions.6: tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
band_descriptions.7: geod_shearrate - Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
band_descriptions.8: geod_dilaterate - Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
band_descriptions.9: tmi_vg - Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
band_descriptions.10: deq_n100a15 - Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)
band_descriptions.11: iso_grav_anom_vg - Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
band_descriptions.12: det_elev - Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
band_descriptions.13: iso_grav_anom - Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
band_descriptions.14: tmi - Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
band_descriptions.15: depth_to_base_surf - Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
band_descriptions.16: ieq_n100a15 - Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)
band_descriptions.17: cond_surf - Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
band_descriptions.18: iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
band_descriptions.19: det_elev_slope - Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending

sentinel.detail: nodata is stored as the float32 min-sentinel, which np.isfinite() accepts as valid data; every reader in this repo masks it with grid.SENTINEL_LIMIT instead

footprint_used.rule: sample-submission finite mask AND every feature band valid, so both the evidence profile and the score are defined at every emitted pixel (template convention)

lidar.note: h_all > 0 means the 3 m detector found a line-persistent step in that cell
